name: Calendar
description: A month of events in a seven-column grid, with colour per calendar, overflow into a day list, and a popover for each event.

props.name: events
props.type: { id: string; title: string; start: string | DateValue; end?: string | DateValue; calendar: string; location?: string; notes?: string }[]
props.description: The events. Dates are ISO strings such as "2027-02-14T09:00" or @internationalized/date values. A start without a time is an all-day event; an event that ends on a later day is drawn as a bar across the days it covers.

props.name: calendars
props.type: { id: string; label: string; color: string }[]
props.description: The calendars events belong to, listed under the month. Timed events show a dot in the calendar's colour; all-day and multi-day events are filled with a tint of it.

props.name: month
props.description: Any day in the month to show (controlled). Use defaultMonth when uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultMonth
props.description: The month shown first. Defaults to the month of today.

props.name: onMonthChange
props.description: Called with the first day of the new month when the arrows, Today or the keyboard change it.

props.name: today
props.description: The day marked with a water circle. When left out it is read from the clock after the first render.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: First column of the week. Defaults to the locale's.

props.name: onEventClick
props.description: Called when an event's details open.

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Called by the New event button with the focused day, and when a day is double-clicked.

props.name: showNewEvent
props.description: Shows the New event button in the header. Set false for a calendar people only read; double-clicking a day still calls onCreate if you pass it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other props go to the root element.
